messages.author: 91bee2fcb8329b57
messages.subject: Google groups and hebrew
parts:
Hi,

I'll ask this question in English, just to emphasize the point...

This is a great forum, especially for Hebrew related issues (encoding, Hebrew and R-Studio, Hebrew and Shiny), but I hardly use it because it's almost impossible to write questions with Hebrew, not to mention mixed English and Hebrew.
So the question is,
1. Is it possible to make the text box right-to-left on Google groups in any way?
2. and if not, maybe we should think of an alternative to Google Groups? (is there an alternative?)

What do you think?
